name: sapar-skills
description: Skills by Sapar for AI agents: MIREA Moodle automation, a read-only SyncShare quiz-coverage audit, and a job-search pipeline (vacancy digest + applying on employer sites), and tg-bridge (Telegram as the human-in-the-loop channel).

plugins.name: mirea-moodle
plugins.description: MIREA Moodle (online-edu.mirea.ru): SSO login with OTP, courses, assignments, folders, downloads, docx→pdf; plus syncshare-audit, a read-only SyncShare quiz-coverage audit.

plugins.name: job-search
plugins.description: job-digest (Telegram/RSS via RSSHub → keyword filter → daily Mail.ru digest), job-apply (drive Chromium to apply on employer career sites with a tailored resume PDF) and job-contacts (find recruiters and team leads from public sources, map hiring, rate-limited outreach); optional Telegram gates, digest buttons and a headless auto-apply queue via tg-bridge.

plugins.name: tg-bridge
plugins.description: Telegram bot as the human-in-the-loop channel: blocking ask with buttons/text reply, notifications, inbox for forwarded messages, one-tap buttons running whitelisted commands.
